metrics.sensor: MAE of the 20 ms sensor change, in native ADC counts; channels 0-5
metrics.fit_scaled_channel_mean: Mean of six channel MAEs divided by their fit-only scales
metrics.count: Poisson negative log probability including log(k!), in nats per sorted unit per 20 ms
metrics.weighting: Mean over issues within original, then equal weight per original; all 93 units equally weighted
metrics.paired_orientation: Comparator minus candidate, positive favors the candidate
metrics.interval: Two-sided 95% percentile, linear interpolation, 4,000 paired whole-original draws, PCG64(270411)
metrics.scope: The joint decision uses Hall channel 5 and spike-count NLL for both prescribed seeds. Channels 0–4 and the scaled six-channel mean are descriptive.
metrics.joint_gate: For both targets at both seeds, balanced must have lower mean loss than equal, single and each simple reference. Comparator minus balanced must also have a strictly positive lower 95% limit against equal and single.
metrics.extended_values: Infinity is exact zero probability on an observed outcome; null denotes an indeterminate contrast
